agua.fuente: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Water Body Mask (WBM, auxiliary file of each tile; class codes: Copernicus DEM Product Handbook v5.0, 2022, section 1.2.5.4, Table 8); Copernicus DEM GLO-30, © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved
agua.remuestreo: majority of the WBM pixels whose centre falls in the cell (Copernicus also used majority resampling for its 8-bit masks, Handbook section 1.2.5); tie -> class of the nearest WBM pixel if tied, else the highest code; cell with no pixel -> nearest; pixel centres placed exactly as for altura.f32; missing WBM tile -> 255

notas: radio_m = WGS84 Gaussian mean radius at 75.3833° (sphere within ~6 m of the ellipsoid over 20 km). GLO-30 is a surface model (DSM). 3.6% of cells are exactly 0 m: sea surface in GLO-30, kept as 0 (not NaN).
